label: early copy-phase echo of specific tokens (3,e,c,t,u,x) in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on the 2nd-4th output steps (recall_idx 1-3; recall_idx 2 carries ~60% of mass), and never in the original phase or at the delimiter. It never fires on a first occurrence of a token (in_first=0 always), i.e. its input is a fed-back copy of an earlier original token. Strongly favours long sequences (L=9 holds 65% of mass, L<=5 essentially never) and absolute steps t=9-11. Token-selective on the fed-back input: 3, e, c, t, u, x dominate (3 strongest, ~27% of mass), with weaker o, v, j and near-zero for f, d, h. Top activations are 3 at recall_idx 2 (e.g. sequences starting v 3 ...). Predicate captures ~77% of mass at ~50% precision on dev; many same-context steps with the preferred tokens do not fire, so magnitude depends on further context not captured here.
